dependencies.reason: The pipeline uses lang.Detect for language detection, lang.Detection.VerifyCommand for verification command resolution, lang.Profile.Targeted for the targeted revert check, and lang.Profile.InlineTests for declaration-level revert.

The pipeline calls engine.NewRun, engine.SetupBranch, engine.Ledger, engine.GateCache, engine.Park, engine.Push, engine.OpenPullRequest, engine.CommonPreflight, engine.Background, and engine.Invalidate.

The pipeline uses prompt.Loader to render all system prompts, phase messages, tool descriptions, refusals and rejections from embedded Markdown templates. The BriefView, PhaseView and AttemptView types are used to build the views.
The conform.Scan call passes ScanInput.Lang so the structural checks use the profile's classifiers. The revert check uses Profile.InlineTests to decide file-level vs declaration-level revert.

tasks.title: Implement per-run scratch directory lifecycle and check-log formatting
steps: Write TS-23-26, TS-23-27, TS-23-28, TS-23-29, TS-23-30 in codefix/scratch_test.go and confirm they fail.

Create codefix/scratch.go with a newRunScratch(root, sessionID string) (string, func(), error) function that creates .agent-fox/scratch/<sessionID>/, writes a .gitignore containing '*' in .agent-fox/scratch/ if it does not exist, and returns the relative path and a cleanup function that removes the directory and its parents when empty.
Add a writeCheckLog(scratchDir, label, output string) (string, error) function that writes the full output to checks/<label>.txt under the scratch directory and returns the absolute path.
Add a formatCheckForPrompt(result checks.Result, label, scratchDir string) string function that returns at most the last 10 lines of output inline plus a ref(path) reference to the full log file.
Handle the error case: when the scratch directory cannot be created, return a warning string and empty scratch path so the run continues without check logs.
Ensure the cleanup function removes .agent-fox/scratch and .agent-fox when they become empty after removing the session directory.
Run the tests and confirm they pass; run make lint.

tasks.title: Implement the targeted revert check with declaration-level revert and commit-object hold
steps: Write TS-23-31 through TS-23-38 in internal/conform/revert_targeted_test.go and codefix/revert_test.go; confirm they fail.

Extend internal/conform/revert.go with a TargetedRevert function that accepts a lang.Profile, a ledger classification of added/edited tests, and a check callback. When the profile has a Targeted command, run it for exactly those tests; when it has no Targeted command, fall back to the full suite and set Mode to 'suite'.
Add a RevertMode field ('targeted' or 'suite') and a Declarations field ([]string) to RevertResult.

Implement the commit-object hold: before reverting, call git stash create when the tree is dirty or create a wip: commit with git reset --soft to undo when clean. Store the commit SHA for restoration.

For profiles with InlineTests, implement declaration-level revert: use the file outline to identify test declarations by line range, revert only the implementation declarations (put back to base), and leave inline test declarations in place. When the outline cannot be parsed, fall back to file-level revert for that file.
Implement failure classification: use the profile to distinguish build failure from test failure. When the profile cannot classify, set Proves to true with Reason 'failure was not classified'.
Handle cancellation during the revert check: restore the implementation from the commit object and propagate the cancellation.
Generalise the existing keepRustTests/rustTestModule to use the profile's InlineTests flag and outline ranges for any language.
Run the tests and confirm they pass; run make lint.

tasks.title: Implement the run_checks model-facing tool with gate cache integration and shell guard
steps: Write TS-23-7 through TS-23-15 in codefix/runchecks_test.go and internal/agentrun/guard_runchecks_test.go; confirm they fail.

Create codefix/runchecks.go with a runChecksTool function that builds a core.Tool named 'run_checks' with a scope parameter (enum: 'lint', 'targeted', 'all', default 'all') and an optional tests parameter (array of strings).

Implement the scope 'lint' handler: run the profile's Lint command, write the full output to the scratch directory via writeCheckLog, and return exit_code, ok, the last 20 lines of output, and the log path.

Implement the scope 'targeted' handler: run the profile's Targeted command for the named tests (or the tests the ledger says the phase has written when tests is empty). When the profile has no Targeted command, fall back to scope 'all' with a note in the result.

Implement the scope 'all' handler: run the full verification command, store the result in the GateCache keyed by tree hash, and return the same result shape. When the tree hash cannot be computed, run without caching.
Implement the budget counter: track scope-all calls per phase; on the third call, answer from the cache with a note that the budget is exhausted.

Wire the shell guard in internal/agentrun/guard.go: extend the suiteRun function to refuse the suite's own command and the profile's untargeted Test command in the implement phase, naming run_checks as the alternative. Ensure targeted forms (with a file, test name, or package argument) are never refused.
Register the run_checks tool alongside submit_implementation in the implement phase's tool list.
Run the tests and confirm they pass; run make lint.

steps: Write TS-23-39, TS-23-40, TS-23-41 in codefix/cancel_test.go; confirm they fail.
